Decipher.com cardlists archive face for [[Cloud City: Dining Room]], '''rotated 180°''' from [[:File:CC-D-cloudcitydiningroom-decipher-archive.gif]] so that the Light Side text ("If you control, Blue Milk, Beru Stew and Yoda Stew are doubled. Jek is deploy -2 here.") reads the right way up. The rotation is lossless: same pixels and palette, no rescaling.

Original face: flush crop + exterior corner pads flood-bleached #FFFFFF (~490×350).
